name: CLAHE Contrast Enhancement Comparison
description:
Perform advanced local contrast enhancement on a microscopy image and create a comparative figure.

1. Open the 'Embryos (42K)' sample image (File > Open Samples > Embryos (42K)).
2. Convert to 8-bit grayscale if necessary.
3. Create a duplicate of the image.
4. Apply CLAHE (Contrast-Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization) to the duplicate to reveal local details. Use standard parameters that visibly improve local contrast.
5. Create a side-by-side comparison montage:
   - Combine the Original and Enhanced images into a Stack.
   - Create a Montage from the stack (2 columns, 1 row).
6. Save the final montage as a PNG file to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/clahe_comparison.png'.

The final image should show the original on the left and the enhanced version on the right.
